description: This file defines enums, structures, constants, and function prototypes related to Cisco GRE (Generic Routing Encapsulation) APIs, including interface configuration and status management.

methods.name: CosaDml_CGreInit
methods.description: Initializes the GRE interface management module.

methods.name: CosaDml_CGreFinalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up the GRE interface management module.

methods.name: CosaDml_CGreIfGetNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Returns the number of GRE interface entries.

methods.name: CosaDml_CGreIfGetEntryByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a GRE interface entry by index.

methods.name: CosaDml_CGreIfSetIns
methods.description: Sets the instance number for a GRE interface.

methods.name: CosaDml_CGreIfGetCfg
methods.description: Gets the configuration of a GRE interface.

methods.name: CosaDml_CGreIfSetCfg
methods.description: Sets the configuration of a GRE interface.

methods.name: CosaDml_CGreIfGetStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for a GRE interface.

methods.name: CosaDml_CGreIfGetStatus
methods.description: Gets the current status of a GRE interface.

methods.name: CosaDml_CGreIfGetLastChange
methods.description: Retrieves the last change timestamp for a GRE interface.

methods.name: CosaDml_CGreIfSetInsAlias
methods.description: Sets the alias for a GRE interface instance.
